## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The pull-request description should include the verification section required by project policy. An optional test addition would protect numeric characters in generated slugs.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- PR body — correctness — This pull-request description omits the required `## Testing` section. AGENTS.md:4 states, “Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified.” Add that section with the verification performed and its results. — The description violates contributor policy and leaves reviewers without the required verification record.

## Suggestions
- app/slug.py:7 — tests — For `Release 2.0`, no test checks that the numeric characters survive as `release-2-0`. The added tests exercise letters, separators, and empty results, while the existing test only imports the package. Add a case containing digits to cover the numeric range in the character class. — A regression that strips digits from numbered page titles could pass the current tests.

## Strengths
- The added tests assert observable results for lowercasing, separator collapsing, trimming, and empty slugs.
- Both new modules begin with purpose docstrings, satisfying AGENTS.md:3.
